representation.transform: featurewise z-score from the same trial calibration, standard-deviation floor 0.30, then observation unit norm

device_boundary.target_input: XVF3800 input :0, two fused CoreAudio channels

frozen_physical_geometry.speaker_arrangement: small left and right speakers stacked vertically with both acoustic centers on the board's 180 degree radial axis
frozen_physical_geometry.speaker_aim: both speakers facing the XVF3800 microphone array center
frozen_physical_geometry.distance_reference: speaker grilles to XVF3800 board center

operator_authorization.user_scope: as many live audio runs as necessary for the project goal
operator_authorization.this_run_scope: one fixed 12-trial calibrated-v2 confirmation, capped at 75.6 seconds total playback

gate_rationale: VISION H2 requires held-out predictive advantage, top-down consumption, and bounded state. Purity is retained as a diagnostic rather than lowered after the prior vowel failure; absolute accuracy is not a substitute for improvement over causal baselines.
failure_policy: Any failed gate is retained. No threshold, seed, grammar, calibration floor, representation, or predictor change may reuse these held-out trials as confirmation.
claim_boundary: A two-family pass would support the bounded calibrated local transition mechanism on controlled real playback/capture. It would not establish unconstrained, semantic, or cross-speaker speech prediction and would not complete H2 without later natural-stream transfer.
